en.quote: …increase investment to at least 25% of GDP by 2015 and 27% by 2018.
en.head: Investment was 20.6% of GDP in 2018.
en.body: Rosstat reported fixed-capital investment at 20.6% of GDP in 2018, against the decree’s target of at least 27% for that year. The figures concern the same measure.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 596, “On Long-Term State Economic Policy”
